# Third-party material

Large SDKs, model binaries, and external audio are not vendored here. Before
adding any third-party material, document:

- its explicit purpose in the project;
- authoritative source and provenance;
- pinned version, release, or commit;
- license review and any required notices or attribution;
- whether it participates in numerical authority or only in tooling,
  diagnostics, or development.

Retain applicable upstream notices with any permitted material. Do not use the
root project licenses to relabel third-party code, models, generated model
artifacts, SDKs, or audio.
